encoder: official RAE Dinov2withNorm, DINOv2-with-registers base, normalize=true
feature: GAP over 256 normalized DINOv2-B patch tokens
noise: (1-alpha)*GAP(x)+(alpha/16)*Normal(0,I), exactly equivalent in distribution to GAP after iid patch noise
augmentation: ADM center crop, no random flip
validation: full ImageNet-1k validation; three independent matched-noise seeds
